title: Switch to LED lighting
description: Replace incandescent and halogen bulbs with LED bulbs. LEDs use 75% less energy and last up to 25 times longer.
impact: Reduces electricity carbon footprint by up to 150 kg CO2e per year.

title: Unplug phantom loads
description: Unplug electronics, chargers, and appliances when not in use. Many devices consume power even when turned off but plugged in (standby power).
impact: Saves up to 10% on your electricity bill and reduces emissions by 50 kg CO2e annually.

title: Optimize heating and cooling
description: Adjust your thermostat. Set it to 24-26°C in summer and 18-20°C in winter. Clean air conditioning filters monthly to maintain efficiency.
impact: Reduces cooling emissions by 15% and saves energy.

title: Install solar panels
description: Transition to solar energy. Solar rooftop panels capture renewable sunlight, lowering your dependence on fossil-fuel powered grids.
impact: Reduces electricity emissions to zero, saving up to 1,500 kg CO2e/year.

title: Optimize LPG usage
description: When cooking, cover your pans with lids to trap heat, cook on medium flame, and use a pressure cooker. Ensure burners are clean and flame is blue.
impact: Lowers LPG cylinder consumption by 20% (approx. 5 kg CO2e saved per cylinder).

title: Carpool to work
description: Share rides with colleagues or neighbors who have similar commute routes. Reduces the number of single-occupancy vehicles on the road.
impact: Cuts individual driving footprint by 50% (saves approx. 2.0 kg CO2e per shared trip).

title: Ride a bicycle for short trips
description: For any distance under 5 km, use a bicycle instead of a car or motorcycle. It emits zero carbon and provides cardiovascular exercise.
impact: Saves 0.24 kg CO2e per kilometer compared to a standard petrol vehicle.

title: Use public transit
description: Take buses, metro, or commuter trains for your daily commute. Public transit occupies less space and uses less energy per passenger-km.
impact: Emits 80% less carbon than driving alone (saves approx. 0.15 kg CO2e per km).

title: Maintain your vehicle
description: Ensure proper tire inflation, get regular oil changes, and keep air filters clean. Proper maintenance increases fuel efficiency.
impact: Improves vehicle mileage by up to 4%, saving 50-80 kg CO2e annually.

title: Switch to electric vehicles (EV)
description: When purchasing a new vehicle, choose an electric vehicle (EV) or a hybrid. EVs produce zero tailpipe emissions and are highly efficient.
impact: Reduces transportation footprint by 70% or more, depending on electricity grid carbon intensity.

title: Transition to plant-based diet
description: Adopt a vegan or vegetarian diet, or participate in 'Meatless Mondays'. Meat production, particularly beef and lamb, requires heavy land, water, and emits methane.
impact: A vegetarian diet emits 50% less carbon than meat-heavy, while vegan emits 70% less.

title: Reduce food waste
description: Plan meals, store food properly, and eat leftovers. Food decaying in landfills releases methane, a highly potent greenhouse gas.
impact: Avoids greenhouse emissions of approx. 2.5 kg CO2e for every kilogram of food saved from landfills.

title: Choose local and seasonal food
description: Buy food grown locally and in-season to minimize 'food miles' (the distance food travels from farm to plate) and energy-intensive greenhouse cultivation.
impact: Reduces food transport emissions by up to 10%.

title: Recycle paper, plastic, and metal
description: Separate recyclable materials from trash. Recycling materials requires significantly less energy than extracting raw virgin resources.
impact: Saves raw resources and reduces landfill footprint by up to 200 kg CO2e annually.

title: Start backyard or indoor composting
description: Compost your organic kitchen waste (fruit peels, vegetable scraps, tea leaves). Creates nutrient-rich soil fertilizer and prevents landfill methane.
impact: Reduces waste carbon output to zero and saves up to 80 kg CO2e/year.

title: Avoid single-use plastics
description: Use reusable grocery bags, water bottles, and steel/glass food containers. Avoid plastic packaging, straws, and disposable cups.
impact: Reduces plastic demand, lowering chemical processing emissions and plastic pollution.

title: Buy items with minimal packaging
description: Buy products in bulk, choose refills, and choose items packaged in recyclable paper or cardboard rather than heavy plastic containers.
